text:
Type: rug
Name: nuLOOM Rikki Braided Border Jute Area Rug, 8' Round, Off-white
Colors: Off-white
Materials: jute
This inherently beautiful jute rug is left in its natural tan color. It will bring a neutral, classic accent to a low-traffic area such as a bedroom. Classic casual style Made of 100% jute Timeless look with durability 8' Diameter Pairs with a rug pad (sold separately) Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag Unroll, allow a few days for natural fibers to settle.
